description:
Generic built-in checker operations run deterministic JIT validation and coverage without subprocess/JIT-source/`jq` dependencies, while the default external-review placeholder records a visible structured warning on a passing run.

## Background

The embedded workflow needs portable deterministic checks and truthful placeholder review behavior. These operations remain generic and data-neutral; this task does not select or author the production profile payload.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Built-in checker types, execution, JSON/schema representation, findings, and tests remain data-neutral and can be assigned arbitrary configured gate keys.
- [hard] REQ-02: The editable review command and embedded placeholder emit an unmistakable warning in human and structured findings, and repository validation warns while a placeholder remains configured.
- [hard] REQ-03: `./scripts/docs-mechanical.sh docs/reference/gate-presets.md docs/reference/rules-and-gates.md` passes for every generated checker/reference change.

## Scope

**Blast radius:** checker domain enum, gate execution/manager, schema/output/findings, validation warning rule, preset consumers, tests, and reference projection; deterministic operations do not shell back into `jit`.

**Green landing:** Generic checker operations and placeholder findings are independently usable by existing gate configuration before the profile package selects them.
title: Provide portable deterministic checks and review warnings
